10+ years of sales experience and 3 - 5 years of people management experience.
Experience leading sales and operations in a high-growth technology environment covering the enterprise customer segment
Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Mandarin as the position requires you to work primarily with customers from Greater China
Ability to hire, train and coach a high-performance sales team.
Ability to build strategic executive relationships with customers and industry thought leaders.
Ability to understand and articulate technical concepts, and translate them into industry- or business-relevant terms.

Demonstrated passion for startups and new technology businesses.
Experience managing customers in the Greater China region

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The SMB team works with European businesses in one of Stripe’s high-growth and highest priority segments. At Stripe, SMB are companies with employee count under 100 employees.
This is an existing business sales team where each AE manages approx 100 accounts. We protect revenue with excellent account management and partner focused relationships, lead on contract renewals with a strong commercial focus and excel in product upsell sales motions.

In this role you and your team will own partnerships between Stripe and the most strategic and fastest-growing SMB and Mid-Market companies in EMEA. As a Sales Manager at Stripe, you’ll play an instrumental role in fueling Stripe’s growth in this high priority segment through coaching your team but also executive engagement across top accounts.
You'll lead and coach high-performing account executives, helping them deliver on ambitious targets, as well as roll up your sleeves to work directly with users and prospects. We are looking for an individual who is keen to work alongside a high-performing team of individuals to navigate complex sales cycles.
You’ll own team performance, focusing both on delivering key sales metrics while also thinking like a CEO to drive internal and external projects to make the team, and the segment, excel. You can balance sales excellence with a builder mentality to hit and exceed targets while setting the team up for long term success.

Recruit, develop and lead a team of sales professionals, with a particular focus on SMB
Help leadership to define and implement the long-term vision and strategy for the team and manage day-to-day operations, with a focus on performance against key sales metrics
Support your team to develop and implement full sales cycle strategies from pipe-gen to deal closing to implementation
Coach and guide the team in developing consultative and solution-based sales skills through all facets of the sales cycle
Solve complex client needs and work across product, sales, risk, and operations together with your team to improve our product
Make sure that internal teams are set up for users’ success by coordinating with other Stripe teams such as Solution architects, SDRs, Marketing, Product and many more
Inspire, motivate and enable personal and career development of team members, both to promote career growth and to increase impact for Stripe

The ideal candidate for this role is someone who thrives in highly ambiguous environments. Our users are some of the most ambitious and demanding customers and a successful candidate will match their curiosity, speed and passion to build things by overcoming challenges. You are solution-oriented, adaptable, have a keen interest in coaching and developing a team of high potential sellers.
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

8+ years of relevant sales experience, including 4+ years of people management experience
Fluency in English and German
Track record of overachieving against ambitious sales targets
Ability to understand complex technical ecosystems and build great relationships with technical customers
Experience consistently forecasting and managing a high growth business for multiple quarters
Ability to hire, train, and coach a high-performance sales team
Ability to build executive relationships with customers and ecosystem partners
A knack for working well with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally
Ability and motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
Superior verbal and written communication skills

Prior experience in payments
Prior experience in a sales and/or customer-facing role at a high growth technology company
Interest in business models and monetization

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The AI GTM team is focused on one of Stripe's most strategic growth opportunities: enabling AI-native and AI-enabled businesses to scale on Stripe. We're in a unique position – partnering with the world's most ambitious AI companies (the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, and NVIDIA) building on the frontier of artificial intelligence – across infrastructure, foundation models, agents, and applications – to grow globally with the help of Stripe's financial infrastructure.
As part of Stripe's GTM organization, this team works closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to shape Stripe's AI GTM strategy and ensure that the world's leading AI companies – from early-stage innovators to the largest public players – choose to build with Stripe.

Work collaboratively with one of Stripe’s most strategic customers to realize their business goals. Our customers in the AI Industry move fast, you’ll work alongside your customer to develop and execute a multi-year partnership strategy that accelerates their ambitions with Stripe as a critical partner.
This is a role that will require you to be an active participant in Stripe’s product strategy across the company, acting as a proxy for your customer within the walls of Stripe. You will interact with executives internally and externally to ensure your customer’s needs are well understood and prioritized. You will:
Own full commercial sales cycles and partnership opportunities, from business case development, to deal structuring and negotiating, to close
Develop a strategic account plan to expand Stripe’s commercial footprint within your customer’s business, driving growth through cross-sell, expansion, and new revenue streams
Drive deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex renewals
Develop relationships with executive stakeholders within your customer’s business, deeply understanding problems they are trying to solve and helping them find durable solutions
Be responsible for account mapping and coordinating meaningful conversations with the appropriate stakeholders, internally and externally, to expand the customer relationship
Lead and contribute to team projects, further Stripe’s use of AI tools and agents, and help refine our sales processes and culture in Stripe’s GTM organization

We're looking for someone who operates with vision and urgency at the highest levels of enterprise sales. You combine deep commercial creativity with the executive presence to negotiate landmark agreements, and the strategic judgment to know which problems matter most. You thrive in ambiguity, create clarity for others, and have a track record of building and closing the largest, most complex deals in your organization's history.

Demonstrated success closing transformational partnerships with bespoke commercial structures
13+ years of sales experience selling technical products to large enterprises, with a sustained track record of top performance and quota overachievement

Superior verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to command a room of senior executives

History of shaping org-wide sales practices, mentoring peers, and contributing to team strategy beyond individual quota attainment

Experience selling into or partnering with frontier AI companies, hyperscalers, or developer-first platforms

Prior experience at a high-growth technology company where you helped define the go-to-market approach for a new or nascent market segment
Familiarity with Stripe's products and the broader fintech/payments ecosystem

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. The Mid-Market Sales Executive is responsible for sales and revenue growth in their assigned, targeted accounts. This individual is responsible for building a sales pipeline, managing a sales process for their mid-market brands/group with 40 to 500 units.
This role can be based in Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane.

Lead efforts to grow Toast market share in the multi-unit restaurant industry through establishment and cultivation of ongoing relationships at the C-Suite level through research, cold-calling and networking to develop a qualified pipeline of prospects.
Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast value proposition of products and solutions through demonstrations and presentations communicating a compelling purchase rationale.
Cultivate relationships with business partner counterparts who sell and support complementary applications and services to point of sale systems serving the restaurant industry
Plan, direct and coordinate sales support activities, including management of the sales pipeline through Toast sales tools (Salesforce)
Involved in all phases of the sales lifecycle including: identifying and developing leads; meeting with clients; developing value propositions; financial deal structuring; contract negotiation and closing
Understand the competitive landscape (strengths, weaknesses, benefits) and determine how to position Toast to win
Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation Teams to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery
Own your own leverage. Continuously identify the repetitive parts of the role-research, prep, notes, follow-up, list building and systematically get them off your plate, so the majority of your week is spent in live conversation with operators.
Work evidence, not alphabetical order. Prioritize accounts based on observable change in the operator's business: expansion, ownership change, hiring patterns, guest feedback trends, visible technology, and disqualify unworkable accounts quickly so your capacity concentrates where it can actually close.
Treat your book as an asset you maintain. Keep account and contact records accurate, current, and deduplicated, understanding that routing, scoring, and every AI-assisted workflow is only as good as the data underneath it.
Untangle who really decides. Resolve complex ownership structures, franchise groups, multiple legal entities, operators running several concepts under different names to identify and reach the actual economic decision maker rather than whoever answers the phone.
Arrive already informed, and earn trust in a low-trust market. Focus on the operator's specific situation rather than a product pitch, and recognize that many operators have been burned by a previous vendor; credibility, not feature comparisons, is often what wins the deal.
Close the loop on what's broken. Flag bad data, wrong contacts, and signals that didn't hold up, so the system your whole team relies on improves rather than quietly eroding.

A combination of SaaS, Digital Marketing and Restaurant Industry Technology experience is required
5+ years of relevant successful technology or professional services sales experience
Previous success in selling/leading sales efforts in environments with 6 to 12 month sales cycles
Proven sales skills in complex deal development, financial structuring, negotiations, and closing with both new and existing clients

s.h: Experience in MEDDPICC Sales Qualification preferred
s.t:
Travel 30% or more
Comfortable with process-driven sales, reporting, and tracking
Strong written and presentation-based communication skills are required
You've built something to make yourself faster. You can walk us through a repeatable process, template or workflow you personally created to eliminate busywork from your own week, and what it gave you back.
Demonstrated learning velocity. You can point to a capability you taught yourself in the last six months without being asked to, and explain how you now use it.
You can articulate a problem precisely. Comfort framing a messy commercial question clearly and specifically enough that a tool, a teammate or a supporting function can actually act on it.
You manage a territory like a portfolio. Comfort making deliberate coverage decisions across a large account base rather than defaulting to whichever deal is loudest this week.
Genuine curiosity about how restaurants actually operate — margins, labour, throughput, the difference between a 3-location operator and a 30-location one — because that is what earns a second conversation. Comfort working in build mode, where territory definition, process and tooling are actively being shaped and you are expected to have an opinion on them.

Join our Movement and Champion Restaurant Culture! 💚
At TheFork we believe that the best things in life happen around the table.
As the leading restaurant booking platform in Europe, we connect the broadest community of loyal diners with the world’s favorite restaurants. Powered by innovation and a deep passion for the restaurant industry, we create unique dining experiences across 11 countries.
We’re part of the Tripadvisor Group and proud to be building a diverse, people-first culture where “respect”, “ownership”, “growth” and “better together” values thrive.
If you’re passionate about food, technology, and making a real impact, your seat at the table is ready.
In the UK, we operate in one of the most competitive and fast-paced restaurant markets, where success requires strong execution, resilience, and commercial drive.
👉 Discover life at TheFork

We are looking for a Key Account Manager Hunter to accelerate TheFork’s growth within the premium independent restaurant segment across key cities in the UK. This includes AA Guide restaurants, fine dining concepts and high-end independent restaurants.
You will build a high-quality pipeline, and lead consultative negotiations end to end with some of the country’s most respected hospitality operators.
This is a field-based role (approx. 50% of your time).

Prospecting and acquiring new premium independent restaurants across key cities in the UK, including AA Guide, fine dining, and high-end independent concepts
Building a strong understanding of your target cities and identifying the independent restaurants with the highest strategic value for TheFork
Generating your own pipeline through targeted outreach, networking, referrals, local market mapping, cold calls and in-person visits
Conducting high-quality meetings and product demos with owners, operators, chefs and general managers to present TheFork’s B2C and B2B value proposition
Managing your pipeline from first contact to negotiation and closing
Sharing market insights and restaurant intelligence with the wider sales team

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
We’re here to give power to the patient.
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Zocdoc's most important asset is our people. As an Account Executive, you will own and grow a portfolio of Zocdoc's largest clients, and you will grow it by creating opportunity, not just maintaining it.

Managing a book of business between $5-10M in revenue, your core job is to expand these partnerships: uncover where each client is leaving growth on the table, build the business case, and drive it to a close.

Microsoft 365 has become the dominant collaboration platform across Government and Education in Australia. The problem is that it’s inherently driven by the business users. Where information is created, how it’s created, who it gets shared with, how long it remains relevant, and how valuable it is all becomes impossible to manage at scale. Factor AI into the mix, and it can rapidly expose sensitive data and contribute to the rising cost of storage.
It’s a problem all agencies and institutions are looking to solve.
As the Enterprise Account Executive, you are responsible for helping these agencies realise the value of the AvePoint Confidence platform to solve these core problems. You will create, qualify, pitch and close all new revenue from organisations upwards of 2000 employees into Australian Public Sector and Education and manage a portfolio of existing organisations .
Using an account team, it is expected that you will build positive relationships and ensure the successful acquisition of our software to solve our customers’ business problems .
An Enterprise Account Executive’s role is to grow the AvePoint customer base through the development and execution of GTM motions in line with market trends. You will work both directly with and through our channel partners to solve customer problems by leveraging the AvePoint Confidence platform. Additionally, you will be required to maintain (renew) and grow (upsell + cross sell) a group of existing AvePoint customers.

Own the full sales cycle: create, qualify, pitch, and close new revenue opportunities with organisations of 2000+ employees.
Build and nurture executive-level relationships to drive adoption of AvePoint solutions.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies aligned with market trends.
Collaborate with channel partners (SI, VAR, MSPs) to deliver customer value.
Potentially manage renewals and growth (upsell/cross-sell) for existing accounts.

The role of Operational Account Manager (Energy Codes) sits within Talan UK's Future Markets function and is part of the Stakeholder Engagement team.
Energy Codes are at the heart of the regulation of the GB energy market, setting the standards for new and improved ways of working. Covering the complete breadth of the market, Code Reform has introduced a new model of cooperation and best practice for Code Management and delivered a new digital, modern, and accessible, consumer-centric code.
Our team of Operational Account Managers is integral to the onboarding and socialisation of these arrangements. The team is responsible for working with Parties to the Codes, and other key stakeholders. They have a primary role, providing named support to multiple parties and stakeholders.

They understand differing party types and individual company needs and recognise where parties may be impacted by changes to the Codes and the way the arrangements work. They are responsible for working with Stakeholders to help them develop their understanding of the code and respective responsibilities within it.
The Operational Account Managers work with all Code Manager functions to understand the scale and impact of change and ensure parties are always informed and supported. They work across the Code Manager teams to ensure new parties are onboarded to the arrangements, and fully supported as they enter the market.

They ensure parties know how to access all elements of the code manager service and how they can provide feedback queries, and improvements to the arrangements. They need to explain the Code strategy in a language and context that is relevant to different organisations, accounting for their market role, experience, and business model.

As well as high-level plans, the Operational Account Managers are sharing information and contributing to the training and development of new parties and new personnel.
The Operational Account Managers have a key supporting role in identifying and predicting change for the market and its participants. They contribute to the strategic direction of the Codes by evaluating its future requirements and assessing the appetite for change amongst parties and categories of Party, which in turn contribute to a more balanced and equitable market.

Create and maintain close working relationships with a wide variety or party types, supporting them in engaging with all aspects of the Code and the services that it provides.
Gather and share feedback on all aspects of the Code and support continuous improvement activities.
Work closely with other Code service providers to onboard parties and stakeholders to the Code and/or Code services, ensuring a smooth journey for applicants and all SLAs are met.
Develop and maintain strong, collaborative working relationships with other Code Managers and Service Providers.
Support the Change Management team with the development of enduring change solutions and ensure that the parties you work with are aware of the changes and the opportunities they have to input to the process.
Understand the impact and scale of change required by their stakeholders and provide an initial impact assessment of change to systems, processes, and code changes.
Supporting the service desk to ensure enquiries are responded to in a timely manner, including addressing Service Desk tickets that are allocated to you for resolution.
Ensuring the team meets its service levels by working to and taking ownership of deadlines.
Drafting and reviewing internal and external documentation, including guidance, communications, and website content to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality.
Analysis of data to identify areas of concern within the arrangements and proactively engage with parties to highlight current and future areas of impact.
Draft and present agenda items to facilitate engagement and debate at industry forums.
Proactively support our Stakeholder Engagement team with projects, changes and or tasks, using your own initiative to manage workload in line with team Service Level Agreements.
Drive efficiency by identifying and leading on opportunities for continuous improvement, championing best practices alongside the wider team, as well as identifying new ways to benefit our clients.

Ability to create resilient relationships
An understanding of differing stakeholder needs and how to put Parties and Consumers at the Heart of the Service
Problem solving – taking ownership for the resolution of issues and queries raised by the Parties you work with
Be ambitious, creative, and innovative, learn lessons from their work, share expertise and continuously learn
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, able to understand and articulate complex issues to all levels of seniority and to technical and non-technical audiences.
A keen eye for detail and the highest standard of quality for themselves and others.
Passionate about delivering an exceptional service and positive outcomes for the market and consumers.
Be a team player, with strong interpersonal skills, working collaboratively towards a shared vision for the future
Upon employment, employees should also have a sound awareness of the Company's Information, Quality, Environmental and Energy Management Systems

A career that lets your passion shine

Your comprehensive annual territory strategy will drive targeted account growth and market influence.
